picks.title: 75-Year-Old Belgian Man Arrested at Suvarnabhumi Airport Under Pattaya Court Warrant
picks.memo: Belgian 'Mr. Herman' (75) arrested on arrival (flight BR67 from Taiwan) at Suvarnabhumi Oct 26 ~11:30 by Pattaya police + Immigration Div 2; Pattaya court warrant (May 22, 2026) for hiding/destroying seized property to evade a court-ordered debt.

picks.title: Customs reports 15 containers held in Laem Chabang waste probe on October 26
picks.memo: Customs DG Phantong: 15 containers detained/opened at Laem Chabang for suspected e-waste; if offences found, legal action under Customs Act 2017 and goods returned at importer cost; follows Rayong/Prachin Buri toxic waste problems.

picks.title: ครอบครัวสัตหีบผวา! แก๊งชายบุกพังบ้าน ทุบรถ 5 คัน หนุ่ม 29 ถูกปืนขู่รุมทำร้าย
picks.memo: Sattahip (Chonburi), Moo 4: group of men smashed a home, damaged 4-5 vehicles, door and CCTV; a 29-year-old was threatened with a gun and beaten; family says no progress in 10+ days and fled; Sattahip police chief says suspects all identified.

picks.title: รวบแล้วมือมีดวัย 20 แทงพ่อค้าพวงมาลัยดับกลางเมืองระยอง ปมแค้นเก่าตามหลอน
picks.memo: Rayong police on Oct 27 arrested Panuwat (20) on court warrant for the Oct 18 fatal stabbing of a 42-year-old garland seller in central Rayong; 19-year-old rider arrested earlier; possible old grudge under investigation.

picks.title: พัทยาจัด Bikini Beach Race 2026 ฉลอง 10 ปี นักวิ่งกว่า 5,000 คน ร่วมวิ่งริมทะเล 31 ต.ค.นี้
picks.memo: Pattaya International Bikini Beach Race 2026 (10th year), Sat Oct 31, 5 km on Pattaya Beach in front of Central Pattaya, start ~17:30, 5,000+ runners/companions from 30+ countries, Halloween theme + Glow Party concert.

picks.title: พัทยาดัน 4 นโยบายท่องเที่ยว ลุ้นเมืองหนังยูเนสโกปี 2570 ชูพัทยาสีเขียว กระตุ้นเศรษฐกิจสร้างสรรค์
picks.memo: Pattaya tourism working group: 4 policy areas incl. applying for UNESCO City of Film by 2027 (2570), at least 2 creative districts (from Naklua), Pattaya Pro Green (cut foam, biodegradable packaging).

picks.title: Pattaya Officials Attend Opening of New Specialized Orthopedic Hospital
picks.memo: EASE Specialized Orthopedic Hospital opened in Pattaya Oct 27; 26 patient rooms, 22 recovery beds, 4 operating rooms, 4 ICU rooms; Mayor Poramese attended.

picks.title: Bangkok weighs 15 baht flat fare for new electric buses
picks.memo: BMTA considering flat 15-baht fare on new e-buses instead of 15/20/25 distance fares; 2,320 e-buses planned, first 1,520 by May 2027, replacing 8-baht buses; needs government approval.

picks.title: Don Mueang Airport to Replace Handheld Metal Detectors With Pat-Down Checks From November 1st
picks.memo: From Nov 1 Don Mueang drops handheld metal detectors; after walk-through/body scanner, staff do pat-downs when needed (CAAT Reg. 113/ICAO); screening may take longer, allow extra time.

picks.title: Bangkok, six provinces on tidal flood alert until Nov 5
picks.memo: DDPM: Bangkok + 6 central provinces may flood from high tides Oct 27-Nov 5, high tides 6am-3pm; low-lying riverside areas and communities outside embankments to watch.

picks.title: Khao San Road plans biggest Halloween party, calls for 4am closing
picks.memo: Khao San Road 'One Halloween' Oct 30-31 from 5pm, up to 60,000 visitors expected over 2 nights, 5M+ baht budget, costume prizes ~1M baht; organisers want 4am closing.

picks.title: Delivery riders criticised after dropping liquid bag from Bangkok BTS station
picks.memo: Viral video: delivery rider dropped a bag of dark liquid from escalator at Siam BTS; online claims it targeted motorcycle taxis; a taxi rider told Channel 8 nobody was hit; riders defended it as a prank.

picks.title: ONE Lumpinee fighter attacked by two men in Chiang Mai
picks.memo: ONE Lumpinee fighter Ngao Phayak (Anucha Phaisanphana, 27) was cut off and punched in his car by two men near a U-turn in Mae Hia, Chiang Mai, Oct 26; facial cuts; attackers fled.

picks.title: Two killed in truck-motorcycle crash near Thepkrasattri Bridge
picks.memo: Oct 27 ~10:55 at Thepkrasattri Bridge exit (Mai Khao, Phuket): 18-wheel truck hit a motorcycle; two passengers died at scene, rider injured.

picks.title: Six arrest warrants issued in VGI share ownership concealment case
picks.memo: ECD + SEC: 6 arrest warrants against Thai/foreign network accused of using offshore entities/funds as nominees to hide true owners of new VGI shares; 4 locations searched Oct 27; SEC used IOSCO info exchange.

picks.title: Cabinet approves B50-billion rooftop solar scheme
picks.memo: Cabinet on Oct 27 approved 50bn-baht rooftop solar programme: 1 million households within a year, 50,000 baht each; MEA/PEA one-stop registration; surplus can be sold to grid. (AM edition covered proposal; this is approval.)

picks.title: Thailand welcomes 25 million foreign tourists in first 10 months
picks.memo: Jan 1-Oct 24: nearly 25M foreign tourists, 1.21tn baht spending, down 4.43% YoY; week Oct 18-24: 501,965 arrivals (+2.99%); China -24.17% week on week, Russia +25.45%.

picks.title: Restaurant YouTube reviewer is a fraudster with an arrest warrant. Police complaint filed in Nonthaburi
picks.memo: Nonthaburi restaurant owner filed complaint Oct 26 against self-styled influencer (36) who demanded 7 dishes + 4 drinks or 25,000 baht, threatening 1-star review; police found existing warrant for public fraud/mule accounts.

picks.title: Chinese travel alert misdirected, claims Sihasak
picks.memo: FM Sihasak: Chinese embassy travel warning targets isolated cases (scam-linked people), not general tourists; urges Beijing to cooperate directly on scam networks; has not yet met Chinese ambassador.

picks.title: Thai nationals rank first for overstaying in Japan with 10,260 cases
picks.memo: Japan ISA: 10,260 Thai overstayers as of July 1, 2026, top spot; Vietnam 10,135; South Korea 3rd with 9,759; total 65,229 (-4.8% from Jan 1).

picks.title: Waterspout hits Trang as rough seas force fishing boats ashore
picks.memo: Oct 27 waterspout off Trang (Hat Samran); hundreds of fishing boats sheltered; Emerald Cave temporarily closed; waves may exceed 2 m; boats under 6 m stay ashore Oct 25-28.

picks.title: อนุทิน พยักหน้ารับลุยฟ้อง ‘ไอซ์ รักชนก’แชร์สลิปปลอม ชี้พิกัดเจ้าของเพจ แถวชลบุรี
picks.memo: Follow-up to fake 7M-baht 'tea money' slip: PM Anutin (12:10 Oct 27, Government House) nodded when asked if he will sue People's Party MP Rakchanok Srinok for sharing it; says page owner located around Chonburi; told police chief to speed cases.

picks.title: เปิด 20 บริษัทเหมืองแร่ จ.ท่าขี้เหล็ก จี้ไทย-เมียนมา หาสาเหตุสารพิษข้ามแดน แม่สาย จ.เชียงราย
picks.memo: Mae Fah Luang Univ. researcher lists ~20 licensed mines in Tachileik (12 gold, 6 manganese, 2 lead), urges Thai-Myanmar border committee to probe cross-border toxins in Mae Sai; suggests temporary halt on ore imports.

picks.title: รฟท. โต้เอกชน เบรกเลิกไฮสปีด 3 สนามบิน ฟ้องค่าสิทธิแอร์พอร์ตลิงก์
picks.memo: SRT governor Anan: 3-airport high-speed rail contract with Asia Era One (CP) not terminated and still in force; SRT disputes CP's July 6 termination request (rebuttal sent Sept 28); Airport Rail Link rights-fee dispute ongoing. (New fact vs AM edition.)
